ai_prompt_template: Product photo edit. Keep the exact same <garment/product> from the reference: <color, texture, cut, details> — identical color, pattern, cut and proportions. Do not redesign, recolor or add anything. Remove <props>. Present it as a clean e-commerce flat-lay, front view, centered, ~70% of frame. Background: seamless warm ivory paper (#F8F5F1), soft daylight from the upper left, faint soft contact shadow. No text, no logos, no stickers, no props, no hands, no body. Square 1:1, photorealistic premium catalog photography.
